newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Oct 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Oct 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Western security chiefs have launched an inquiry into reports that Iran will be able to produce its own advanced chemical weapons within a year.
- UAE insurance sector revenue climbs 3.8 percent in 1995 to 1.92 billion dirhams, the planning minister said.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states have allocated $43 billion for energy projects in the coming decade, according to the Oil Enterprises Financing Co.
- UAE retail sector has suffered a drop in business in the wake of a market shrinkage caused by tougher residence and employment visa rules.
- Chinese communications minister opens shipping firm in Dubai.
